:::{#exm-realization}
#### Realizations of the number of heads

In @exm-random-variable, let $X$ be the number of heads in two fair coin flips.
Run the experiment once and suppose it produces $\outcome = HT$.
Then the [realization](#def-realization) of $X$ is $x = X(HT) = 1$.
Running the experiment again might produce $TT$, with realization $x = 0$.
The variable $X$ is the same both times;
only its realization changes.

:::
